answer: An admission auction stops a sybil spiral: each epoch sells only a fixed number of seats, and every agent must bid real POA to win one. Like a timber auction, a buyer who wants 1000 fake identities must outbid honest agents 1000 times: at 5 POA per seat that is 5000 POA locked up front, while one honest agent pays just 5 POA. Seats are scarce like quartz, so mass forgery is unaffordable and honest agents earn their stake back through real work.
